lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A recurring grid of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in four to five primary horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, creating a series of orthogonal anchor points across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high-intensity highlights on the dorsal-facing edge to low-intensity shadows on the ventral-facing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark, elongated silhouettes (remoras) attached to the ventral region and the posterior edge of the pectoral fin.
